name: Zechariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood above the people and asked why they transgressed the commandments so that they could not prosper, telling them that because they had forsaken the Most High, He had also forsaken them.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: From the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar: they even followed this man into the temple. They would have probably tried to go into the holies of holies to kill a brother. Unbelievable. That's what happens when you're moved with hatred.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: Upon them comes all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias.

note.label: Matthew 23: The Woes upon the Scribes and Pharisees
